description: Verify that the RENEWING-state DHCPREQUEST is unicast to the IP carried in Option 54 (server identifier) (RFC 2131 §4.4.5)
approach:
[Objective]
In RENEWING the binding is still valid; the client just wants to extend it with the server it already has. RFC 2131 §4.4.5 says the renewal REQUEST is unicast to the server-id (NOT broadcast — that would be REBINDING).

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DORA → BOUND with Option 54 = SERVER_ID.
2. T1 fires; DUT enters RENEWING and emits a renew DHCPREQUEST.
   • IPv4 dst_ip == SERVER_ID   ← key check

[Pass condition]
RENEWING REQUEST's IPv4 dst_ip equals the snapshotted Option 54.

[Fail condition]
Any chain step missing OR Fail_renewing_request_dst_not_server_id — REQUEST went somewhere else.

verdicts.Pass: RENEWING REQUEST unicast to server-id — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_discover: No DUT DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window
verdicts.Fail_no_renewing_request: No DUT renewing DHCPREQUEST within listen window
verdicts.Fail_renewing_request_dst_not_server_id: RENEWING REQUEST dst_ip is not the server identifier
